description: This file implements a saturation-aware, priority-based dynamic rate limiter as part of a larger system for managing API request rates. It defines a class `_PROXY_DynamicRateLimitHandlerV3` that handles pre-call rate limit checks, saturation monitoring, and token usage tracking using a three-phase approach (read-only check, enforcement decision, counter increment). The implementation leverages Redis for distributed tracking, manages priorities, and integrates with existing infrastructure such as `litellm` and FastAPI.

classes.name: _PROXY_DynamicRateLimitHandlerV3
classes.description: A saturation-aware, priority-based rate limiter that manages API request rates through a three-phase approach. It integrates with Redis for distributed tracking, supports enforcing model capacity at 100%, and tracks user priorities to ensure fair resource allocation under saturation conditions.
